cases.sentence: Скажи ___, чтобы мужчины и женщины попросили у соседей.
cases.translation: Tell the people, so that men and women ask of their neighbors.
cases.explain: The verb сказать (to tell someone) takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Мужчины и женщины попросили у ___ серебряных и золотых вещей.
cases.translation: The men and women asked of their neighbors for silver and gold items.
cases.explain: The preposition у governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Самого Моисея считали великим ___ в Египте.
cases.translation: Moses himself was considered a great man in Egypt.
cases.explain: The verb считать (to consider someone something) takes the predicate in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я покараю ___ и Египет еще лишь раз.
cases.translation: I will punish Pharaoh and Egypt just one more time.
cases.explain: The direct object of the transitive verb покарать takes the accusative; for an animate noun it equals the genitive form.

cases.translation: About midnight I will pass through Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition по governs the dative case.

cases.translation: All the firstborn in Egypt will die.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: И Моисей, кипя ___, вышел от фараона.
cases.translation: And Moses, seething with anger, went out from Pharaoh.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the manner (seething with anger).

cases.sentence: Он не отпустил израилетян из своей ___.
cases.translation: He did not let the Israelites go out of his country.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

reading.question: Besides people, what else was to die?
options: Even the firstborn offspring of the livestock
All the crops of the field
reading.correct: Even the firstborn offspring of the livestock
reading.explain: The text says 'Умрет даже первородный приплод скота' (even the firstborn of the livestock will die).

reading.ru: По всему Египту будет громкий плач, подобного которому не бывало прежде и не будет впредь.
reading.question: What is said about the great cry throughout Egypt?
options: There has never been one like it before, nor will there be again
It would last exactly seven days
It would come only from the Israelites
It would be silent and unnoticed
reading.correct: There has never been one like it before, nor will there be again
reading.explain: The text says the cry would be 'подобного которому не бывало прежде и не будет впредь' (like none before or after).

reading.ru: Но на израилетян и на их скот даже собака не залает.
reading.question: What is said about the Israelites during this event?
options: Not even a dog will bark at them or their livestock
They will lose their firstborn as well
They will flee into the mountains
They will fight against the Egyptians
reading.correct: Not even a dog will bark at them or their livestock
reading.explain: The text says 'даже собака не залает' at the Israelites or their livestock.

reading.ru: Тогда вы узнаете, что Господь делает различия между Египтом и Израилем.
reading.question: What will the people come to know?
options: That the Lord makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel
That Egypt is mightier than Israel
That Israel will remain in Egypt
reading.correct: That the Lord makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel
reading.explain: The text says the Lord 'делает различия между Египтом и Израилем' (makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel).

reading.ru: И Моисей, кипя гневом, вышел от фараона.
reading.question: In what state did Moses leave Pharaoh?
reading.explain: The text says Moses left 'кипя гневом' (seething with anger).

reading.ru: Моисей и Аарон сотворили перед фараоном все эти чудеса, но Господь сделал сердце фараона упрямым, и он не отпустил израилетян из своей страны.
reading.question: What was the outcome after Moses and Aaron performed the wonders?
options: The Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart and he did not let Israel go
Pharaoh freed the Israelites at once
The Egyptians began to worship the Lord
reading.correct: The Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart and he did not let Israel go
reading.explain: The text says the Lord 'сделал сердце фараона упрямым' and Pharaoh did not release the Israelites.
